longBusinessSummary: Enerflex Ltd. offers modular natural gas, power technology, and treated water solutions in North America, Latin America, and the Eastern Hemisphere. The company's portfolio includes compression, processing, cryogenic, treated water solutions, and energy infrastructure portfolio includes energy infrastructure solutions under contract for natural gas processing, compression, and treated water equipment. It also provides contract operations services that includes trained personnel, equipment, tools, materials, and supplies to meet natural gas needs, electric power, and produced water needs as well as designing, sourcing, installing, operating, servicing, repairing, and maintaining equipment.
